description: Type library inventory: create ADODB.Command and describe its whole containing type library through ITypeInfo (every type, interface, dispid, invoke kind, vtable slot and parameter type); then, on an open ACE connection, describe the live type of the Properties collection, a Property, a Recordset, its Fields collection, a Field and that Field's Properties, the Errors collection (after a failing Execute) and an Error, and a Command's Parameters collection and a Parameter. Asks the declared OLE DB-facing ADO surface and the live interfaces each object returns.
retentionNote: Designed r-oledb-odbc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
